key_custody_establishment.software_boundary: No Gpg4win installation, key generation, private key import, production policy or baseline change is performed by this evidence update.

role_separation.recovery_recipient: Recovery primary/decryption subkey remain on a custodian-controlled offline encrypted medium; only the public certificate goes to the server.
role_separation.backup_signer: A different signing-only key is available to the backup operation in a dedicated server GnuPG home. Its private signing key cannot decrypt recovery backups.
role_separation.restore: Existing restore.py needs local GnuPG decryption capability. Offline private custody plus a public-key upload does not implement a remote/hardware decryption bridge or constitute a successful actual restore.

proposed_internal_RnD_parameters.reason: Explicit compatibility-oriented instructions for existing RSA-capable GnuPG code; actual cross-version smoke verification is still required.

steps.action: If gpg is absent, obtain Gpg4win from its official site and verify installer integrity/signature before installing. This is a manual tool preparation step, not server software admission.

steps.where: Trusted workstation; encrypted removable media disconnected from repository sync
steps.action: Choose the actual encrypted media folder; F: below is an example and must be replaced. Use a NEW dedicated GnuPG home and a nonempty passphrase entered only in the GnuPG prompt. Do not reuse the sample path blindly or overwrite an existing keyring.
PowerShell_commands: $CustodyRoot = Read-Host "输入已解锁的加密离线介质目录，例如 F:\MediaTraceKeyCustody"
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $CustodyRoot -PathType Container)) { throw "请先准备并确认加密介质目录" }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $CustodyGpg) { throw "专用密钥目录已存在，请先核查，不要重复生成" }
gpg --homedir "$CustodyGpg" --quick-generate-key "MediaTrace RnD Recovery - Xu Changsheng" rsa4096 cert 1y
$RecoveryFpr = (Read-Host "输入刚生成的恢复主密钥完整指纹，不是口令") -replace "\s", ""
if ($RecoveryFpr -notmatch "^[A-Fa-f0-9]{40}(?:[A-Fa-f0-9]{24})?$") { throw "完整指纹格式无效" }
steps.expected: Exact primary fingerprint plus a distinct encryption subkey; no shared-server generation and no empty passphrase.

steps.action: Export the public recipient separately. Keep encrypted private-key export and revocation certificate on custodian-controlled encrypted offline media, with a second independently stored copy; do not publish revocation material or private exports.
steps.expected: Public recipient contains exactly the chosen primary and encryption subkey; private export/revocation material never enter Git, cloud-sync folders or chat.

steps.backup_code_boundary: backup.py and restore.py intentionally use --pinentry-mode error. They do not prompt for a passphrase. An attended separate benign signing/decryption check may unlock the dedicated agent before a short operation; absent/expired agent authorization must fail. Do not add password arguments, empty-passphrase keys or persistent unattended credential caches to bypass this. Unattended daily backups require a separately established controlled signing/token facility.
steps.cache_cleanup: After the attended operation, gpgconf --homedir DEDICATED_GNUPG_HOME --kill gpg-agent terminates only that dedicated agent; use the actual home and do not stop unrelated agents.
